Fuelled by great people whose expertise and creativity sets the standards in our industry, we’re inspired by the opportunities to innovate and break boundaries. We’re proud to play a part in protecting the world’s democracies. And we’re committed to putting sustainability at the centre of everything we do, opening up and protecting our planet. With over 16,000 employees across 32 manufacturing sites in 12 countries we serve over 90% of the world’s aircraft and engine manufacturers and achieved sales of £3.6bn in 2025. There are no limits to where you can take your career. Job Summary As MES/MOM engineer at GKN Aerospace in Papendrecht, The Netherlands, you will be involved in the Development, Implementation, Validation and Support of our Manufacturing Execution System (MES) solution based on Siemens Opcenter Execution, deployed at sites in the APAC, EU and NA regions. Job Responsibilities Support and maintain current MES deployments in multiple Production sites. Package and deploy new GKN customization releases to Test and Production environments. Install/upgrade and configure Opcenter for new implementations and deployments. Set up and maintain integrations with surrounding applications using Opcenter Connect MOM. Understand business processes and functional requirements and convert into technical specifications. Translate functional and design specifications into MES objects: workflows, equipment classes, etc. Develop custom logic when justified by a valid business case and no out of the box solution is available. Define test specifications, participate in tests and validation. Develop tools and templates to speed up the design process, make the support process more efficient and increase application stability and usability. Conduct technical training when required to share development best practices. Job Qualifications To help us make a difference, you’ll bring your passion and talent for what you do along with the following skills, experience, qualifications and attributes: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or equivalent work experience. Minimum of 5 years of working experience in a similar role. Extensive experience in Windows server administration, application management and configuration including IIS, certificates, services, firewall, Powershell. Experience with Kubernetes and managing applications running as Docker Containers an Extensive experience in Oracle/MS SQL database management and query methods. Experience with Siemens Opcenter Execution (formerly known as Camstar), including Designer, Portal Studio, Opcenter Connect MOM or similar experience. Experience with Mendix development. Knowledge of basic programming languages such as .NET, HTML, C++/C#, XML/XSL/XSD, VB Script. Experience in supporting and troubleshooting applications, ideally in the field of manufacturing or production. Experience in supporting the implementation of software solutions and participating in IT projects. Strong commitment and responsibility to maintain and support production environments. review_candidates.title: Project Manager_LN
review_candidates.description: JOB SUMMARY: The Project Manager is responsible for leading a cross departmental team to fulfill project goals and objectives. This position is responsible for managing risk, quality and progress of projects to organizational standards, and ensures projects are completed on time, on budget, to quality standards, and within agreed scope. The projects will tend to be medium to high complex in nature, has multi-department to enterprise-wide impact, and require a medium to large body of project resources. To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential function with or without reasonable accommodation. Main Tasks And Responsibilities Define project scope, goals and deliverables that support business goals in collaboration with senior management and stakeholders. Effectively, communicate project expectations to team members and stakeholders in a timely and clear fashion. Liaise with project stakeholders on an ongoing basis. Set and continually manage project expectations with team members and other stakeholders. Plan and schedule project timelines and milestones using appropriate tools. Track project milestones and deliverables. Determine the frequency and content of status reports from the project team, analyze results, and troubleshoot problem areas. Define project success criteria and disseminate them to involved parties throughout project life cycle. Conduct project postmortems (i.e. lessons learned) and create recommendations reports to identify successful and unsuccessful project elements. Estimate the resources and participants needed to achieve project goals. Draft and submit budget proposals and recommend subsequent budget changes where necessary. Where required, negotiate with other department managers for the acquisition of required staff time. Determine and assess need for additional staff and/or consultants and make the appropriate recruitment if necessary, during project cycle. Direct and manage project development from beginning to end. Develop full-scale project plans and associated communications documents. Delegate tasks and responsibilities to appropriate project team members and staff. Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team. Identify and manage project dependencies and critical path Develop and deliver progress reports, proposals, requirements documentation, and presentations. Proactively manage changes in project scope, identify potential crises, and devise contingency plans. Coach, mentor, motivate and supervise project team members and contractors, and influence them to take positive action and accountability for their assigned work. Build, develop, and grow any business relationships vital to the success of the project. Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed in this document are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and not necessarily comprehensive. Minimum Qualifications Typically, a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering. Equivalent combination of relevant education and experience may be substituted as appropriate. Master of Business Administration is preferred 7+ years hands on experience in leading medium to highly complex department and/or enterprise projects spanning across multi-disciplined areas, including 3+ years working with manager or director level. Core Adept Capabilities: Project Management, Influence and Negotiate, Deliver Results, Think and Solve Problems Core Intermediate Capabilities: Manage and Develop People, Finance, Act with Integrity Industry Project Management Certification (e.g. PMP, Prince2) Ability to operate a personal computer and other standard office equipment. Intermediate to advanced proficiency in working with Microsoft Office Suite, project management software, diagram/process flow software, conference software, and statistical software. Strong troubleshooting and technical research abilities a must. Must demonstrate the ability to work in a high pressure, fast-paced environment. Must be able to effectively multi-task with complete follow through. Must be energetic, self-motivated, and flexible. Excellent interpersonal/communication/written/documentation skills. Must have the ability to communicate technical information to non-technical users. Demonstrated experience in resource management. Experience at working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment is essential. Can conform to shifting priorities, demands and timelines through analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Reacts to project adjustments and alterations promptly and efficiently. Flexible during times of change. Ability to read communication styles of team members and contractors who come from a broad spectrum of disciplines. Persuasive, encouraging, and motivating. Ability to elicit cooperation from a wide variety of sources, including middle to upper management, clients, and other departments. Ability to defuse tension among project team, should it arise. Ability to bring projects to successful completion through political sensitivity. Strong written and oral communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills. Adept at conducting research into project-related issues and products. Must be able to learn, understand, and apply new technologies. Excellent customer service skills. Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment is crucial. Some travel may be required for the purpose of meeting with clients, stakeholders, or off-site personnel/management. Physically able to participate in training sessions, presentations, and meetings Desirable Multi-year hands-on working experience in at least two functional areas (operations, finance, sales/marketing, human resources, client services) and at least one information technology area (infrastructure, support, design, development, testing) Certified in an industry recognized process Improvement or quality program (e.g. Six Sigma, TQM) Experience working within a humanitarian development agency Experience working for a private or public agency funding NGOs. Experience in working under multi-cultural and diverse environments. Experience in working for a global entity with reaches across a 12-hour time zone Experience in consulting, sales and/or client services Fluency in any of the following languages: Arabic, Spanish, Swahili, French.
